Disease Outbreak Hits Oil & Gas Services Workforce in Indonesia

A sudden outbreak of respiratory illness has struck workers at multiple Oil & Gas Services & Equipment industry sites in Indonesia, causing significant operational disruptions and raising concerns over worker safety. Among the companies affected is Mitra Energi Persada Tbk PT, which confirmed on Thursday that dozens of its field staff are currently undergoing medical observation.

The outbreak, first reported late last week at a major service yard in East Kalimantan, has since spread to at least two other sites operated by industry firms. Symptoms include high fever, coughing, and respiratory distress, according to industry health officers. No fatalities have been reported so far, but several workers have been hospitalized as a precautionary measure.

Operations at some facilities have been scaled back or temporarily suspended to allow for deep cleaning and to prevent further transmission. “The safety of our workforce is the top priority,” said Dedi Rahman, spokesperson for Mitra Energi Persada Tbk PT. “We are working closely with health authorities and have implemented strict hygiene protocols at all affected locations.”

According to the Indonesian Oilfield Services Association, up to 15% of the workforce at the impacted sites are currently on medical leave. “This is an unprecedented situation for our industry,” said association chairman Bimo Santoso. “We are coordinating efforts to contain the outbreak and ensure business continuity while protecting our employees.”

Workers’ unions have raised concerns about the adequacy of protective measures. “We urge all companies to provide sufficient personal protective equipment and clear information to their staff,” said union representative Lina Putri.

The situation remains fluid, with industry leaders meeting regularly to assess developments. Authorities have not yet identified the source of the outbreak, and health teams continue to monitor the health of workers at all affected Oil & Gas Services & Equipment sites.
